model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL laying down management, conservation and control measures applicable in the Area of Application of the Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA)

summary.text: This proposal aims to establish rules for managing fish stocks and monitoring fishing activities in the Southern Indian Ocean to ensure sustainable use of marine resources in that region. It would set out conservation measures and control procedures that fishing vessels and operators would need to follow when operating in these international waters.
